title: CCPA Fines ExportersIndia Operator Rs 10 Lakh Over Unverified Picric Acid Listings
case_name: Central Consumer Protection Authority proceedings against Weblink Private Limited (ExportersIndia.com)
citation: Case No. CCPA-2/54/2026-CCPA, order dated 10 September 2026
card_summary: The CCPA fined Weblink Private Limited, which runs the B2B platform ExportersIndia.com, Rs 10 lakh for picric acid listings that did not disclose a seller's PESO licence or verify the buyer's identity. Weblink argued it was a non-transactional directory protected under Section 79 of the IT Act, but the authority rejected that and imposed the penalty under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
card_tip: A B2B listing platform cannot lean on intermediary status under the IT Act once the CCPA finds it hosted hazardous-chemical listings without licence or buyer verification.
verification_notes: Penalty amount (Rs 10 lakh), order date (10 September 2026), case number (CCPA-2/54/2026-CCPA), the picric acid subject matter, and Weblink's Section 79 defence are corroborated across Digital Policy Alert and TaxGuru, with the Daily Pioneer and related coverage confirming the wider CCPA crackdown on hazardous-chemical listings across e-commerce and B2B platforms of which this order forms part.
